title: Geometry-Aware Score-Repellent Monte Carlo
abstract: arXiv:2611.08909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The recently proposed Score-Repellent Monte Carlo (SRMC) method improves MCMC sampling by tilting the target density $\pi$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with the factor $\exp(-\alpha\,\theta_n^\top s(x))$, where the score function $s(x) = \nabla_x \log \pi(x)$, and $\theta_n$ is the score average from past samples. However, a single scalar repellence strength $\alpha\ge0$ cannot handle both the steep and the flat directions in anisotropic energy landscapes at once. We introduce \emph{Geometry-Aware SRMC} (GA-SRMC), which generalizes the Euclidean alignment to $\theta^\top M s(x)$ for any symmetric positive-definite matrix $M$. translated_title: 几何感知的分数排斥蒙特卡罗方法
translated_abstract: 最近提出的分数排斥蒙特卡罗（SRMC）方法通过在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中以因子 $\exp(-\alpha\,\theta_n^\top s(x))$ 对目标密度 $\pi$ 进行倾斜来改进 MCMC 采样，其中分数函数 $s(x) = \nabla_x \log \pi(x)$，$\theta_n$ 是来自历史样本的分数平均值。然而，单一的标量排斥强度 $\alpha\ge0$ 无法同时处理各向异性能量地形中的陡峭方向与平坦方向。我们提出几何感知 SRMC（GA-SRMC），将欧氏对齐推广为 $\theta^\top M s(x)$ 的形式，其中 $M$ 为任意对称正定矩阵。在 $M$ 的迹约束条件下，基于随机逼近的中心极限定理证明，迹归一化的逆 Fisher 矩阵 $M_{\rm opt}\propto S^{-1}$ 是最坏方向协方差界的唯一最小化器，从而将 Fisher 信息 $S=\text{Cov}_\pi(s,s)$ 从提提议侧预条件子（例如 FisherM……）提升为排斥机制本身的核心组件。
tldr: 本文提出几何感知的分数排斥蒙特卡罗方法（GA-SRMC），用迹归一化的逆 Fisher 矩阵替代单一标量排斥强度，并从理论上证明其能最优地同时应对各向异性能量地形中的陡峭与平坦方向，从而改进 MCMC 采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Geometry-Aware Score-Repellent Monte Carlo (GA-SRMC), which replaces the single scalar repellence strength with a trace-normalized inverse Fisher matrix, theoretically proven to be the unique optimizer that simultaneously handles both steep and flat directions in anisotropic energy landscapes for improved MCMC sampling.
